newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BAYER LEVERKUSEN MISS CHANCE TO CATCH BAYERN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAYER LEVERKUSEN MISS CHANCE TO CATCH BAYERN.

text.p: Bayer Leverkusen missed a chance to catch Bundesliga leaders Bayern Munich on Saturday when they allowed hosts Borussia Moenchengladbach to snatch a 2-2 draw with a last-minute goal.
Leverkusen, who are now two points behind Bayern, stormed ahead in the first half with a goal in the first minute by Niko Kovac and another by German international Ulf Kirsten just before halftime.
But Leverkusen could not hold on to their lead, letting in Jorgen Pettersson in the 65th minute and fellow Swede Martin Dahlin just before the whistle.
Meanwhile, third-placed VfB Stuttgart narrowed the gap between themselves and Leverkusen with a 3-0 rout of relegation-bound St Pauli.
Bayern now have the chance to put a five-point cushion between themselves and Leverkusen if they beat local rivals 1860 Munich in the Olympic Stadium on Sunday.
